item.title: LOKI Star Jonathan Majors "Movie Comeback" With RED DAWN-Inspired Daily Wire Action Flick
item.description: Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania star Jonathan Majors' attempted comeback continues, with a new action movie that starts shooting this week and is being produced by The Daily Wire.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BEYOND THE SPIDER-VERSE Producers Detail Major Changes To Long-Delayed Threequel
item.description: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Man producers Phil Lord and Christopher Miller have explained the threequel's repeated delays, confirming that the movie has to undergo significant changes.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Reportedly A "Literal" Adaptation Of These Beloved Comic Book Runs
item.description: According to a new report, Avengers: Doomsday is a literal adaptation of some very specific comic books that deal with Incursions, the Multiverse, and the rise of Doctor Doom.

item.title: SCREAM 7 Star Neve Campbell Denies Reports That She's Joined The Cast Of X-MEN '97 Season 2
item.description: Despite seemingly being confirmed by former showrunner Beau DeMayo, Scream 7 star Neve Campbell has denied reports that she will voice Polaris in the second season of X-Men '97...

item.title: MARVEL MAXIMUM COLLECTION Brings Arcade And 16-Bit Marvel Classics Back To Modern Consoles
item.description: Limited Run Games has announced MARVEL MaXimum Collection, bringing six classic Marvel titles and 13 retro versions to modern platforms with online play, bonus features, and more.

item.title: MONARCH: LEGACY OF MONSTERS Producer Reveals Why Season 2 Only Features Godzilla, Kong, And Titan X
item.description: The upcoming second season of Monarch: Legacy of Monsters will only feature two familiar Titans, along with a newly created effort. Now, one of the show's producers has explained why.

item.title: Iconic Museum Scene From 1989 BATMAN Recreated In LEGO BATMAN: LEGACY OF THE DARK KNIGHT Cinematic
item.description: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight brings the iconic 1989 Batman museum scene to life in playful LEGO form, featuring the Joker, Prince’s “Partyman,” and a hero-packed adventure across Gotham.
